mapper.select: SELECT FROM target.if_simulation WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
SELECT FROM target.if_simulation ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100
UPDATE target.if_simulation SET uses=uses+1 WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND interface_id=#{interfaceId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND expires_at > clock_timestamp() AND uses < 20 RETURNING uses
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO target.if_target_receipt(request_id,trace_id,attempt_id,simulation_id,simulation_sequence,planned_http_status) VALUES(#{requestId},#{traceId},CAST(#{attemptId} AS uuid),CAST(#{id} AS uuid),#{sequence},#{httpStatus})
